purpose: the seven team-seasons that close the measured Historical V6 pool gap. Built with the certified V4 adapter path unchanged.

selectionCriteria: coach resolves to a repository coach id
five documented starters with per-season career tables
rationale.franchiseDiversityCost: three of the seven are Boston Celtics seasons. The only 1950s and 1960s coaches in src/v3/data/coaches.js are John Kundla and Red Auerbach, and the policy requires a resolvable coach, so early-era choices are narrow. Recorded rather than hidden.
styleDiversityAdded: four-out spacing with rim anchor (2008-09 Magic)
scheme-heavy defence with slow pace (2011-12 Bulls)
